name: Transaction Operation Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the type of process related to a specific transaction.

AMND.name: Amendment
AMND.definition: Transaction amends a previously sent transaction.

CANC.name: Cancellation
CANC.definition: Transaction requests the deletion/cancellation of a previously sent transaction.

CORR.name: Correction
CORR.definition: Transaction corrects errors in a previously sent transaction.
